items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: they had him recording with Jimmy Dorsey's band

ctx.x: Somebody like Dorsey--one of the bands like Dorsey--this white band--wanted Peanuts and Peanuts told him to forget about it, he was a friend.
I was playing down here at the Blazer and one of the guys who was playing with Dorsey at the time told me that we tried to grab your trumpet player and he wouldn't come with us.
I know Charlie Barnett wanted him.
